articles.headline: Hong Kong's Economy Posts Fastest Nine-Month Growth in Five Years
articles.summary_html:
Hong Kong’s economy expanded at its fastest nine-month pace in five years, according to advance estimatespreliminary figures released before the final, confirmed data初步估算數字 published by the Census and Statistics Department on Monday. Real gross domestic product grew 5.2 per cent year on yearcompared with the same period twelve months earlier與去年同期比較 in the third quarter, comfortably eclipsing forecaststurning out higher than experts had predicted超出預期 of 3.7 per cent and quickening from the 4.2 per cent pace logged in the second quarter. On a quarter-on-quarter, seasonally adjustedcompared with the immediately preceding three months, after removing the effect of regular seasonal patterns按季度並經季節性調整 basis, the economy grew 1.9 per cent.

The latest reading extends Hong Kong’s run of growth to a fifteenth consecutive quarter of expansionthe fifteenth three-month period in a row in which the economy has grown rather than shrunk連續第十五個季度擴張, with officials attributing the surge largely to exports. Shipments of goods surged 30.4 per cent, buoyed by continued global demand for artificial-intelligence-related hardware and electronic components, while private consumptionspending by households on goods and services私人消費 rose 2.8 per cent as retail sales and local dining steadily recovered. For the first nine months of the year as a whole, the economy expanded by 5.1 per cent, the strongest such run in five years.

Financial Secretary Paul Chan said the figures reflected resilient economic momentumthe strength and pace at which growth is being sustained經濟動力 despite lingering uncertainty over global trade tensions and the pace of interest-rate cuts abroad, adding that the government may revise its full-year growth forecast upward when revised figures are released on November 13. Economists cautioned, however, that the export-led rebound could prove uneven, since much of the growth is concentrated in a narrow range of high-value technology goods, leaving sectors such as retail and tourism to continue their slower, more gradual recovery.
articles.summary_zh_html:
根據政府統計處星期一公布的初步估算數字，香港經濟創下五年來最快的首三季增長步伐。本地生產總值在第三季按年增長5.2%，遠遠超出預期的3.7%幅度，並較第二季的4.2%進一步加快。若以按季度並經季節性調整計算，經濟增長1.9%。

最新數據令香港經濟增長勢頭延續至連續第十五個季度擴張，官員指出，增長主要由出口帶動。貨物出口受惠於全球對人工智能相關硬件及電子零件的持續需求，大幅上升30.4%；同時，私人消費因零售及本地飲食業持續復甦而上升2.8%。今年首三季整體計算，經濟增長達5.1%，是五年來同期最強勁的表現。

財政司司長陳茂波表示，數據反映香港經濟動力仍然強韌，儘管全球貿易緊張局勢及海外減息步伐仍存在不明朗因素；他並補充，政府在11月13日公布經修訂數字時，或會上調全年經濟增長預測。不過，經濟學者提醒，由出口帶動的反彈可能並不均衡，因為大部分增長集中於小部分高增值科技產品，而零售及旅遊等行業的復甦步伐則依然較為緩慢。
articles.image_scene: A wide shot of Hong Kong's Kwai Tsing Container Terminal at dusk, rows of brightly coloured shipping containers stacked beside towering blue cranes loading boxes onto a large cargo vessel; in the foreground, two anonymous dockworkers in hard hats and reflective vests check a clipboard beside a forklift, with the city skyline faintly visible through the haze behind.

slides.support_zh: 出口強勁帶動就業、薪酬及商界信心，為香港經濟復甦注入動力。

slides.question_zh: 香港是否應過度依賴出口帶動增長，還是應加大力度支持零售及旅遊等行業？

articles.headline: Lawmakers Pass Bill Forcing Crypto Firms to Report Customer Data
articles.summary_html:
Hong Kong's Legislative Council passed a bill on Wednesday requiring cryptocurrency exchanges, brokers and other digital-asset firms to collect and hand over customer transaction records to the taxman, in a move officials say will close loopholes used for cross-border tax evasionavoiding tax by hiding income or assets in another country跨境逃稅. The Inland Revenue (Amendment) (Crypto-Asset Reporting Framework and Amended Common Reporting Standard) Bill 2026 cleared its third readingthe final vote stage by which a bill officially becomes law三讀 after lawmakers debated concerns from the digital-asset industry over implementation costs.

Under the new regulatory frameworkthe system of rules used to oversee an activity監管框架, crypto-asset service providers with a reporting nexusa legal connection to a place that obliges a business to report there申報聯繫 to Hong Kong, including exchanges, brokers and operators of cryptocurrency ATMs, must register with the Inland Revenue Department and carry out due diligencethe careful checks a business must perform before acting盡職審查 on their customers. Data collection begins on January 1, 2027, with the automatic exchange of informationthe routine sharing of financial data between tax authorities without a specific request資料自動交換 with partner jurisdictions to follow from 2028, aligning the city with international standards set by the Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development.

Industry groups broadly welcomed the move as a step that would bolster Hong Kong's credibility as a regulated financial hub, though some warned that the new compliance burdenthe cost and effort involved in following rules and regulations合規負擔 could weigh heavily on smaller start-ups. The Hong Kong Securities and Futures Professionals Association said it backed the framework in principle but urged regulators to allow more flexible record-keeping arrangements for firms with limited manpower. Officials maintain that the rules target systemic tax avoidance rather than ordinary retail investors, and stressed that failing to register or report accurately could still expose firms to penalties under the ordinance.
articles.summary_zh_html:
香港立法會星期三通過一項法案，要求加密貨幣交易所、經紀及其他數碼資產公司收集客戶交易紀錄並交予稅務機關，官員表示此舉旨在堵塞被用於跨境逃稅的漏洞。《2026年稅務（修訂）（加密資產報告框架及經修訂共同匯報標準）條例草案》在議員就業界對實施成本的疑慮進行辯論後，完成三讀程序。

根據新的監管框架，與香港具有申報聯繫的加密資產服務提供者，包括交易所、經紀及加密貨幣自動櫃員機營運商，均須向稅務局登記，並對客戶進行盡職審查。資料收集工作將於2027年1月1日展開，與其他司法管轄區之間的資料自動交換則由2028年起實施，使香港與經濟合作與發展組織所訂立的國際標準看齊。

業界普遍歡迎此舉，認為有助鞏固香港作為受規管金融中心的信譽，但亦有意見擔心新增的合規負擔可能令規模較小的初創企業承受較大壓力。香港證券及期貨從業員協會表示原則上支持新框架，但促請監管機構為人手有限的公司提供更具彈性的紀錄保存安排。官員強調，新規定針對的是系統性逃稅行為，而非一般散戶投資者，並指出未能登記或準確申報的公司仍可能須根據條例承擔罰則。
articles.image_scene: A modern Hong Kong office interior: a close-up of an anonymous finance professional in business attire at a sleek desk, reviewing a tablet showing abstract glowing blue cryptocurrency coin icons and rising chart lines with no legible text, a skyline of Central's skyscrapers visible through a floor-to-ceiling window behind.

articles.headline: Nick Cheung to Headline First-Ever Variety Show at Hong Kong Coliseum
articles.summary_html:
Actor Nick Cheung Ka-fai is set to headline a three-day variety showa stage programme that combines different kinds of entertainment such as comedy, singing and dancing綜藝表演 at the Hong Kong Coliseum this coming Lunar New Year, marking his first time leading such a production at the 12,500-seat venue. The veteran performer announced The ChaChaFai Show on Thursday, revealing that the run will take place from February 6 to 8, coinciding with the first three days of the Lunar New Yearthe lunar calendar festival marking the start of the Chinese new year農曆新年 holiday.

Rather than mount a conventional concert, Cheung said he wanted the show to feel like a full stage productionan organised theatrical performance built around sets, scripts and staging舞台製作, weaving comedy sketches, songs and dance numbers around a loose narrative thread. In a promotional video released alongside the announcement, Cheung revisited five of his best-known signature rolesthe parts an actor is most famous for playing代表角色, from the boxing drama Unbeatable to the gangster comedy The Conman 1999, before appearing in a white tuxedo to confirm the show in person.

Industry observers see the production as both a box-office drawsomething expected to attract large paying audiences票房保證 and a calculated appeal to nostalgiaa sentimental longing for the past懷舊情懷, as fans who grew up watching Cheung's films are invited to relive familiar characters in a fresh format. The Coliseum, long associated with pop concerts by Cantopop stars, has in recent years begun hosting a wider range of formats, and organisers say the elaborate live stagingthe physical setting and arrangement of a performance on stage現場舞台布置 for Cheung's show is still being finalised ahead of ticket sales.
articles.summary_zh_html:
影星張家輝將於即將來臨的農曆新年期間，領銜主演一場為期三日的綜藝表演，在可容納12,500人的香港體育館舉行，是他首次在此場館擔綱此類製作。這位資深演員星期四宣布舉行《ChaChaFai Show》，透露演出將於2月6日至8日舉行，正值農曆新年假期首三日。

張家輝表示，他不希望以傳統演唱會形式呈現，而是希望整個演出猶如一場完整的舞台製作，將喜劇環節、歌曲及舞蹈編排在一條鬆散的故事線之中。在隨公布發布的宣傳片中，張家輝重現五個他最為人熟悉的代表角色，包括拳擊電影《激戰》及黑幫喜劇《賭俠1999》中的角色，最後以一身白色禮服現身，親自確認演出。

業界人士認為，這次製作既是票房保證，亦是對懷舊情懷的精心迎合，讓一班自小觀看張家輝電影長大的影迷，可以在全新形式下重遇熟悉的角色。香港體育館一向與粵語流行音樂巨星的演唱會關係密切，但近年開始接納更多元化的演出形式，主辦單位表示，張家輝演出的現場舞台布置仍在最後定案階段，尚未公開發售門票。
articles.image_scene: A wide front-of-house view of the Hong Kong Coliseum's circular arena at night, rows of empty red seats sloping up toward the ceiling, a brightly lit round stage at the centre strung with colourful spotlights and hanging banners with no readable text; an anonymous stagehand in dark clothing wheels a rolling equipment case across the empty stage floor.

articles.headline: Investment Scams Drain Over $60 Million in a Week, Police Say
articles.summary_html:
Hong Kong police revealed this week that residents lost more than $60 million to online investment scamsfraudulent schemes that trick victims into believing they are making a profitable investment投資騙案 in just seven days, with more than 30 cases reported across the city. The single largest loss involved a woman who was lured into a bogus platforma fake service or website set up to deceive people虛假平台 claiming to offer lucrative returns on environmental projects, ultimately parting with $45 million.

According to police, the victim was first approached online and gradually persuaded to open an account on the platform, where a dashboard showed what appeared to be steadily rising returns. She then made more than 60 separate transfers into various personal bank accountsbank accounts held in an individual's own name, often used here to move stolen funds個人銀行帳戶, acting on instructions relayed by fake customer-service representativesstaff who claim to handle customer inquiries and requests客戶服務代表 who assured her that larger deposits would unlock bigger profits. By the time she grew suspicious, her life savingsall the money a person has accumulated over many years畢生積蓄 had already been transferred to accounts controlled by so-called money mulespeople who move illegally obtained money on behalf of others, usually through their own bank accounts洗錢工具人.

Officers urged the public to treat unsolicited investment offers, especially those promising guaranteed or unusually high returns, as a red flaga warning sign that something may not be legitimate危險訊號. They also advised residents to verify any platform's licence with the Securities and Futures Commission before transferring money, and to be especially wary of pressure to act quickly or to use personal rather than corporate bank accounts for payment. Police said investigations into this latest wave of scams were ongoing, with officers tracing the flow of funds through multiple accounts in an effort to identify the organisers.
articles.summary_zh_html:
香港警方本週透露，過去七日內有市民因網上投資騙案損失超過6,000萬元，全港共錄得逾30宗案件。當中損失最大的一宗涉及一名女子，她被誘騙加入一個聲稱提供環保項目豐厚回報的虛假平台，最終損失4,500萬元。

警方指出，受害人最初在網上被搭訕，並逐步被說服在該平台開戶，平台的儀表板顯示回報持續上升。她隨後分開逾60次，將款項轉入多個個人銀行帳戶，過程中一直按照冒充客戶服務代表的指示行事，對方聲稱存入更多款項便可解鎖更高利潤。到她開始生疑時，她的畢生積蓄早已轉入由所謂洗錢工具人控制的帳戶。

警方促請市民將未經請求的投資邀約，尤其是承諾保證或異常高回報的項目，視為危險訊號。他們亦建議市民在轉帳前，先向證券及期貨事務監察委員會核實平台的牌照，並特別留意任何要求盡快行動，或要求使用個人（而非公司）銀行帳戶付款的要求。警方表示正就最新一輪騙案展開調查，追查款項流向多個帳戶的軌跡，以圖辨識幕後主腦。
articles.image_scene: A close-up, respectful shot of an anonymous middle-aged woman's hands holding a smartphone at a kitchen table at home, the phone screen showing an abstract blurred chart of rising green graph lines with no legible text or logos, a cup of tea beside an open bank passbook, soft daytime light coming through a nearby window.

trends.headline: 🥮🚫 North Point Egg-Roll Shop Bans Queue-Jumpers for the Rest of November
trends.summary_html:
A seven-decade-old North Point egg-roll shop, known locally as Tak Shing Ho, has become an unlikely hero on Threads after staff refused to serve a group of queue-jumperspeople who unfairly move ahead of others waiting in a line插隊者 caught on camera cutting into its famously long queue.

A customer who posted the video said she had tried in vain to call outto publicly criticise someone for unacceptable behaviour公開指責 the group herself before alerting a staff member at the till, who then pointed out each queue-jumper by name and refused to sell them anything, declaring they would be barred from buying its handmade treats for the rest of the month.

The clip of the old-school eaterya traditional, long-established small shop or restaurant老字號食店 standing up for its patient customers quickly drew praise, with commenters framing it less as public shamingexposing someone's wrongdoing to public criticism, often online公開羞辱 and more as simple fairness, vowing fresh customer loyaltythe consistent support customers give to a particular business顧客忠誠度 toward a grassroots businessa small, often family-run enterprise rooted in the local community草根生意 that still queues people the old-fashioned way.
trends.summary_zh_html:
北角一間逾七十年歷史的蛋卷老店「德成號」，因店員拒絕售賣予一班在鏡頭下被拍到插隊者的顧客，在Threads上意外成為網民心中的英雄。

上載影片的顧客表示，她曾嘗試親自公開指責這班插隊者，卻未能阻止對方，於是轉而向收銀處店員反映，店員隨即逐一指出插隊者，拒絕售賣任何產品，並表明整個月內都不會再賣貨給他們。

這間老字號食店為耐心排隊的顧客「出頭」的片段迅速獲得網民讚賞，不少人認為這並非公開羞辱，而只是公道之舉，並表示會對這間仍以傳統方式讓顧客排隊的草根生意投以新一輪顧客忠誠度。

causes.label: Queue etiquette as a measure of civic trust
causes.label_zh: 排隊禮儀作為公民互信的量度
causes.text: Hongkongers often treat an orderly queue as an unspoken social contract, so a single act of queue-jumping can feel like a small but real breach of mutual trust between strangers. The shop's firm response struck a chord precisely because it publicly reaffirmed a rule most customers already follow without being asked.
causes.text_zh: 香港人普遍視有序排隊為一種無聲的社會契約，因此單一次插隊行為，對陌生人之間的互信而言，也可能是一次微小卻真實的破壞。這間老店的強硬回應之所以引起共鳴，正正因為它公開重申了大部分顧客本已自覺遵守的規則。

causes.label: Supporting a grassroots shop against anonymous queue-cutters
causes.label_zh: 支持草根老店對抗匿名插隊者
causes.text: Many commenters framed their support less as anger at the queue-jumpers and more as loyalty to a small, handmade-goods shop competing against chain bakeries, seeing the incident as a chance to champion a business that still rewards patience and fairness rather than convenience or connections.
causes.text_zh: 不少留言者表示，他們的支持較少出於對插隊者的憤怒，更多是對一間與連鎖麵包店競爭的手工小店的支持，並視此事為一次機會，去聲援一間仍以耐心與公道、而非方便或人脈作為回報準則的小店。

causes.label: When online call-outs tip into disproportionate punishment
causes.label_zh: 網絡公開指責有時演變成不成比例的懲罰
causes.text: Some commentators questioned whether naming the queue-jumpers on video and barring them for an entire month was proportionate, warning that a minor lapse in manners can snowball into lasting public humiliation once it is filmed and shared, with no clear way for those involved to apologise and move on.
causes.text_zh: 有評論質疑在影片中指名插隊者並禁止其購買整整一個月是否合乎比例，並警告一次輕微的失儀行為，一經拍攝及廣傳，可能演變成持續的公開羞辱，而涉事者卻缺乏明確途徑道歉並重新開始。

causes.label: A small shop's queue policy as a test of community support
causes.label_zh: 小店的排隊政策成為社區支持的考驗
causes.text: The episode also doubles as free publicity for a shop that limits daily stock and operates only on certain days, with its handling of the queue-jumpers reinforcing an image of scarcity and authenticity that keeps customers willing to wait for hours rather than buy a mass-produced alternative.
causes.text_zh: 這次事件同時為一間每日限量、只於特定日子營業的小店帶來免費宣傳，其處理插隊事件的方式，強化了一種稀有與原汁原味的形象，令顧客仍然願意花上數小時排隊，而非購買大量生產的替代品。
